verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, par la volonté de Dieu, pour annoncer la promesse de la vie qui est en Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እንደሚሆን የሕይወት ተስፋ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.en: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.fr: Timothée, mon enfant bien-aimé: que la grâce, la miséricorde et la paix te soient données de la part de Dieu le Père et de Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur!
verses.am: ለተወደደው ልጄ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከጌታችንም ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.en: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.fr: Je rends grâces à Dieu, que mes ancêtres ont servi, et que je sers avec une conscience pure, de ce que nuit et jour je me souviens continuellement de toi dans mes prières,
verses.am: ሌትና ቀን በልመናዬ ሳላቋርጥ ስለማስብህ እንደ አባቶቼ አድርጌ በንጹሕ ሕሊና የማመልከውን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.en: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.fr: me rappelant tes larmes, et désirant te voir afin d''être rempli de joie,
verses.am: እንባህን እያሰብሁ በደስታ እሞላ ዘንድ ላይህ እናፍቃለሁ።

verses.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.fr: gardant le souvenir de la foi sincère qui est en toi, qui habita d''abord dans ton aïeule Loïs et dans ta mère Eunice, et qui, j''en suis persuadé, habite aussi en toi.
verses.am: በአንተ ያለውን ግብዝነት የሌለበትን እምነትህን አስባለሁ፤ ይህም እምነት ቀድሞ በአያትህ በሎይድ በእናትህም በኤውንቄ ነበረባቸው፥ በአንተም ደግሞ እንዳለ ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je t''exhorte à ranimer le don de Dieu que tu as reçu par l''imposition de mes mains.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት፥ እሳት እንደሚያቀጣጥል ሰው፥ እጆቼን በመጫኔ በአንተ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ እንድታነሣሣ አሳስብሃለሁ።

verses.en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est pas un esprit de timidité que Dieu nous a donné, mais un esprit de force, d''amour et de sagesse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልና የፍቅር ራስንም የመግዛት መንፈስ እንጂ የፍርሃት መንፈስ አልሰጠንምና።

verses.en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.fr: N''aie donc point honte du témoignage à rendre à notre Seigneur, ni de moi son prisonnier. Mais souffre avec moi pour l''Evangile, par la puissance de Dieu
verses.am: እንግዲህ በጌታችን ምስክርነት ወይም በእስረኛው በእኔ አትፈር፥ ነገር ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ኃይል መጠን ስለ ወንጌል አብረኸኝ መከራን ተቀበል፤

verses.en: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.fr: qui nous a sauvés, et nous a adressé une sainte vocation, non à cause de nos oeuvres, mais selon son propre dessein, et selon la grâce qui nous a été donnée en Jésus-Christ avant les temps éternels,
verses.am: ያዳነን በቅዱስም አጠራር የጠራን እግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ ይህም እንደ ራሱ አሳብና ጸጋ መጠን ነው እንጂ እንደ ሥራችን መጠን አይደለም፤ ይህም ጸጋ ከዘላለም ዘመናት በፊት በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተሰጠን፥

verses.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.fr: et qui a été manifestée maintenant par l''apparition de notre Sauveur Jésus-Christ, qui a détruit la mort et a mis en évidence la vie et l''immortalité par l''Evangile.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.fr: C''est pour cet Evangile que j''ai été établi prédicateur et apôtre, chargé d''instruire les païens.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.fr: Et c''est à cause de cela que je souffre ces choses; mais j''en ai point honte, car je sais en qui j''ai cru, et je suis persuadé qu''il a la puissance de garder mon dépôt jusqu''à ce jour-là.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለ እምነትና ፍቅር አድርገህ፥ ከእኔ የሰማኸውን ጤናማ ቃል ምሳሌ ያዝ፤

verses.en: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Retiens dans la foi et dans la charité qui est en Jésus-Christ le modèle des saines paroles que tu as reçues de moi.
verses.am: መልካሙን አደራ በእኛ በሚኖረው በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.fr: Garde le bon dépôt, par le Saint-Esprit qui habite en nous.
verses.am: በእስያ ያሉቱ ሁሉ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ እንዳሉ ታውቃለህ፥ ከእነርሱም ፊሎጎስና ሄርዋጌኔስ ናቸው።

verses.en: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.fr: Tu sais que tous ceux qui sont en Asie m''ont abandonné, entre autres Phygelle et Hermogène.
verses.am: ጌታ ልሄኔሲፎሩ ቤተ ሰዎች ምሕረትን ይስጥ፥ ብዙ ጊዜ አሳርፎኛልና፤

verses.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.fr: Que le Seigneur répande sa miséricorde sur la maison d''Onésiphore, car il m''a souvent consolé, et il n''a pas eu honte de mes chaînes;
verses.am: በሰንሰለቴም አላፈረበትም፥ ነገር ግን በሮሜ ባደረ ጊዜ ፈልጎ ፈልጎ አገኘኝ፤

verses.en: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.fr: au contraire, lorsqu''il est venu à Rome, il m''a cherché avec beaucoup d''empressement, et il m''a trouvé.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ከጌታ ምሕረትን እንዲያገኝ ጌታ ይስጠው፤ በኤፌሶንም እንዴት እንዳገለገለኝ አንተ በደኅና ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.fr: Que le Seigneur lui donne d''obtenir miséricorde auprès du Seigneur en ce jour-là. Tu sais mieux que personne combien de services il m''a rendus à Ephèse.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ከጌታ ምሕረትን እንዲያገኝ ጌታ ይስጠው፤ በኤፌሶንም እንዴት እንዳገለገለኝ አንተ በደኅና ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Toi donc, mon enfant, fortifie-toi dans la grâce qui est en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለው ጸጋ በርታ።

verses.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.fr: Et ce que tu as entendu de moi en présence de beaucoup de témoins, confie-le à des hommes fidèles, qui soient capables de l''enseigner aussi à d''autres.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች የመሰከሩለትን ከእኔም የሰማኸውን ሌሎችን ደግሞ ሊያስተምሩ ለሚችሉ ለታመኑ ሰዎች አደራ ስጥ።

verses.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Souffre avec moi, comme un bon soldat de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እንደ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በጎ ወታደር ሆነህ፥ አብረኸኝ መከራ ተቀበል።

verses.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.fr: Il n''est pas de soldat qui s''embarrasse des affaires de la vie, s''il veut plaire à celui qui l''a enrôlé;
verses.am: የሚዘምተው ሁሉ ለጦር ያስከተተውን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ትዳር በሚገኝበት ንግድ ራሱን አያጠላልፍም።

verses.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.fr: et l''athlète n''est pas couronné, s''il n''a combattu suivant les règles.
verses.am: ደግሞም በጨዋታ የሚታገል ማንም ቢሆን፥ እንደሚገባ አድርጎ ባይታገል፥ የድሉን አክሊል አያገኝም።

verses.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.fr: Il faut que le laboureur travaille avant de recueillir les fruits.
verses.am: የሚደክመው ገበሬ ፍሬውን ከሚበሉት መጀመሪያ እንዲሆን ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.fr: Comprends ce que je dis, car le Seigneur te donnera de l''intelligence en toutes choses.
verses.am: የምለውን ተመልከት፤ ጌታም በነገር ሁሉ ማስተዋልን ይስጥህ።

verses.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de Jésus-Christ, issu de la postérité de David, ressuscité des morts, selon mon Evangile,
verses.am: በወንጌል እንደምሰብከው፥ ከሙታን የተነሣውን፥ ከዳዊት ዘርም የሆነውን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አስብ፤

verses.en: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.fr: pour lequel je souffre jusqu''à être lié comme un malfaiteur. Mais la parole de Dieu n''est pas liée.
verses.am: ይህንም በመስበክ እንደ ክፉ አድራጊ እስክታሰር ድረስ መከራ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን አይታሰርም።

verses.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je supporte tout à cause des élus, afin qu''eux aussi obtiennent le salut qui est en Jésus-Christ, avec la gloire éternelle.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እነርሱ ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለውን መዳን ከዘላለም ክብር ጋር እንዲያገኙ ስለ ተመረጡት በነገር ሁሉ እጸናለሁ።

verses.en: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.fr: Cette parole est certaine: Si nous sommes morts avec lui, nous vivrons aussi avec lui;
verses.am: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው እንዲህ የሚለው። ከእርሱ ጋር ከሞትን፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ በሕይወት እንኖራለን፤

verses.en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.fr: si nous persévérons, nous régnerons aussi avec lui; si nous le renions, lui aussi nous reniera;
verses.am: ብንጸና፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ እንነግሣለን፤ ብንክደው፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ይክደናል፤

verses.en: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.fr: si nous sommes infidèles, il demeure fidèle, car il ne peut se renier lui-même.
verses.am: ባናምነው፥ እርሱ የታመነ ሆኖ ይኖራል፤ ራሱን ሊክድ አይችልምና።

verses.en: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.fr: Rappelle ces choses, en conjurant devant Dieu qu''on évite les disputes de mots, qui ne servent qu''à la ruine de ceux qui écoutent.
verses.am: ይህን አሳስባቸው፥ በቃልም እንዳይጣሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ምከራቸው፥ ይህ ምንም የማይረባ የሚሰሙትንም የሚያፈርስ ነውና።

verses.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.fr: Efforce-toi de te présenter devant Dieu comme un homme éprouvé, un ouvrier qui n''a point à rougir, qui dispense droitement la parole de la vérité.
verses.am: የእውነትን ቃል በቅንነት የሚናገር የማያሳፍርም ሠራተኛ ሆነህ፥ የተፈተነውን ራስህን ለእግዚአብሔር ልታቀርብ ትጋ።

verses.en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.fr: Evite les discours vains et profanes; car ceux qui les tiennent avanceront toujours plus dans l''impiété,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍ ራቅ፤ ኃጢአተኝነታቸውን ከፊት ይልቅ ይጨምራሉና፥ ቃላቸውም እንደ ጭንቁር ይባላል፤

verses.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.fr: et leur parole rongera comme la gangrène. De ce nombre sont Hyménée et Philète,
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሄሜኔዎስና ፊሊጦስ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.fr: qui se sont détournés de la vérité, disant que la résurrection est déjà arrivée, et qui renversent la foi de quelques uns.
verses.am: እነዚህም። ትንሣኤ ከአሁን በፊት ሆኖአል እያሉ፥ ስለ እውነት ስተው፥ የአንዳንዶችን እምነት ይገለብጣሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.fr: Néanmoins, le solide fondement de Dieu reste debout, avec ces paroles qui lui servent de sceau: Le Seigneur connaît ceux qui lui appartiennent; et: Quiconque prononce le nom du Seigneur, qu''il s''éloigne de l''iniquité.
verses.am: ሆኖም። ጌታ ለእርሱ የሆኑትን ያውቃል፥ ደግሞም። የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ከዓመፅ ይራቅ የሚለው ማኅተም ያለበት የተደላደለ የእግዚአብሔር መሠረት ቆሞአል።

verses.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.fr: Dans une grande maison, il n''y a pas seulement des vases d''or et d''argent, mais il y en a aussi de bois et de terre; les uns sont des vases d''honneur, et les autres sont d''un usage vil.
verses.am: በትልቅም ቤት የእንጨትና የሸክላ ዕቃ ደግሞ አለ እንጂ የወርቅና የብር ዕቃ ብቻ አይደለም፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለክብር፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለውርደት ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.fr: Si donc quelqu''un se conserve pur, en s''abstenant de ces choses, il sera un vase d''honneur, sanctifié, utile à son maître, propre à toute bonne oeuvre.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ማንም ራሱን ከእነዚህ ቢያነጻ፥ ለክብር የሚሆን የተቀደሰም ለጌታውም የሚጠቅም ለበጎም ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ዕቃ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.fr: Fuis les passions de la jeunesse, et recherche la justice, la foi, la charité, la paix, avec ceux qui invoquent le Seigneur d''un coeur pur.
verses.am: ከክፉ የጎልማሳነት ምኞት ግን ሽሽ፥ በንጹሕም ልብ ጌታን ከሚጠሩ ጋር ጽድቅን እምነትን ፍቅርን ሰላምን አጥብቀህ ተከተል።

verses.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.fr: Repousse les discussions folles et inutiles, sachant qu''elles font naître des querelles.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጠብን እንዲያመጣ አውቀህ ከሰነፎችና ካልተማሩ ምርመራ ራቅ፤

verses.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.fr: Or, il ne faut pas qu''un serviteur du Seigneur ait des querelles; il doit, au contraire, avoir de la condescendance pour tous, être propre à enseigner, doué de patience;
verses.am: የጌታም ባሪያ ለሰው ሁሉ ገር ለማስተማርም የሚበቃ ለትዕግሥትም የሚጸና ሊሆን እንጂ ሊጣላ አይገባውም።

verses.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.fr: il doit redresser avec douceur les adversaires, dans l''espérance que Dieu leur donnera la repentance pour arriver à la connaissance de la vérité,

verses.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.fr: et que, revenus à leur bon sens, ils se dégageront des pièges du diable, qui s''est emparé d''eux pour les soumettre à sa volonté.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር እውነትን ያውቁ ዘንድ ንስሐን ይሰጣቸዋልና ፈቃዱን ለማድረግ በዲያብሎስ ሕያዋን ሆነው ከተያዙበት ወጥመድ ወጥተው፥ ወደ አእምሮ ይመለሳሉ ብሎ የሚቃወሙትን በየዋህነት ይቅጣ።

verses.en: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.fr: Sache que, dans les derniers jours, il y aura des temps difficiles.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመጨረሻው ቀን የሚያስጨንቅ ዘመን እንዲመጣ ይህን እወቅ።

verses.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.fr: Car les hommes seront égoïstes, amis de l''argent, fanfarons, hautains, blasphémateurs, rebelles à leurs parents, ingrats, irréligieux,
verses.am: ሰዎች ራሳቸውን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉና፥ ገንዘብን የሚወዱ፥ ትምክህተኞች፥ ትዕቢተኞች፥ ተሳዳቢዎች፥ ለወላጆቻቸው የማይታዘዙ፥ የማያመሰግኑ፥

verses.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.fr: insensibles, déloyaux, calomniateurs, intempérants, cruels, ennemis des gens de bien,
verses.am: ቅድስና የሌላቸው፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ዕርቅን የማይሰሙ፥ ሐሜተኞች፥ ራሳቸውን የማይገዙ፥ ጨካኞች፥ መልካም የሆነውን የማይወዱ፥

verses.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.fr: traîtres, emportés, enflés d''orgueil, aimant le plaisir plus que Dieu,
verses.am: ከዳተኞች፥ ችኩሎች፥ በትዕቢት የተነፉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ተድላን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.fr: ayant l''apparence de la piété, mais reniant ce qui en fait la force. Eloigne-toi de ces hommes-là.
verses.am: የአምልኮት መልክ አላቸው ኃይሉን ግን ክደዋል፤ ከእነዚህ ደግሞ ራቅ።

verses.en: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.fr: Il en est parmi eux qui s''introduisent dans les maisons, et qui captivent des femmes d''un esprit faible et borné, chargées de péchés, agitées par des passions de toute espèce,

verses.en: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.fr: apprenant toujours et ne pouvant jamais arriver à la connaissance de la vérité.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቶች ሾልከው እየገቡ፥ ኃጢአታቸው የተከመረባቸውን በልዩ ልዩ ምኞትንም የሚወሰዱትን ሁልጊዜም እየተማሩ እውነትን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን ሞኞችን ሴቶች የሚማርኩ፥ ከእነዚህ ዘንድ ናቸውና።

verses.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.fr: De même que Jannès et Jambrès s''opposèrent à Moïse, de même ces hommes s''opposent à la vérité, étant corrompus d''entendement, réprouvés en ce qui concerne la foi.
verses.am: ኢያኔስና ኢያንበሬስም ሙሴን እንደ ተቃወሙት፥ እንዲሁ እነዚህ ደግሞ አእምሮአቸው የጠፋባቸው ስለ እምነትም የተጣሉ ሰዎች ሆነው፥ እውነትን ይቃወማሉ።

verses.en: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.
verses.fr: Mais ils ne feront pas de plus grands progrès; car leur folie sera manifeste pour tous, comme le fut celle de ces deux hommes.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የእነዚያ ሞኝነት ደግሞ ግልጥ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሞኝነታቸው ለሁሉ ይገለጣልና ከፊት ይልቅ አይቀናላቸውም።

verses.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.fr: Pour toi, tu as suivi de près mon enseignement, ma conduite, mes résolutions, ma foi, ma douceur, ma charité, ma constance,
verses.am: አንተ ግን ትምህርቴንና አካሄዴን አሳቤንም እምነቴንም ትዕግሥቴንም ፍቅሬንም መጽናቴንም ስደቴንም መከራዬንም ተከተልህ፤

verses.en: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.fr: mes persécutions, mes souffrances. A quelles souffrances n''ai-je pas été exposé à Antioche, à Icone, à Lystre? Quelles persécutions n''ai-je pas supportées? Et le Seigneur m''a délivré de toutes.
verses.am: በአንጾኪያና በኢቆንዮን በልስጥራንም የሆነብኝን የታገሥሁትንም ስደት ታውቃለህ፤ ጌታም ከሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.en: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.fr: Or, tous ceux qui veulent vivre pieusement en Jésus-Christ seront persécutés.
verses.am: በእውነትም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔርን እየመሰሉ ሊኖሩ የሚወዱ ሁሉ ይሰደዳሉ።

verses.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.fr: Mais les hommes méchants et imposteurs avanceront toujours plus dans le mal, égarant les autres et égarés eux-mêmes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክፉዎች ሰዎችና አታላዮች፥ እያሳቱና እየሳቱ፥ በክፋት እየባሱ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.fr: Toi, demeure dans les choses que tu as apprises, et reconnues certaines, sachant de qui tu les as apprises;
verses.am: አንተ ግን በተማርህበትና በተረዳህበት ነገር ጸንተህ ኑር፥ ከማን እንደ ተማርኸው ታውቃለህና፤

verses.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: dès ton enfance, tu connais les saintes lettres, qui peuvent te rendre sage à salut par la foi en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ከሕፃንነትህም ጀምረህ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን በማመን፥ መዳን የሚገኝበትን ጥበብ ሊሰጡህ የሚችሉትን ቅዱሳን መጻሕፍትን አውቀሃል።

verses.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.fr: Toute Ecriture est inspirée de Dieu, et utile pour enseigner, pour convaincre, pour corriger, pour instruire dans la justice,

verses.en: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.fr: afin que l''homme de Dieu soit accompli et propre à toute bonne oeuvre.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ፍጹምና ለበጎ ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ያለበት መጽሐፍ ሁሉ ለትምህርትና ለተግሣጽ ልብንም ለማቅናት በጽድቅም ላለው ምክር ደግሞ ይጠቅማል።

verses.en: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.fr: Je t''en conjure devant Dieu et devant Jésus-Christ, qui doit juger les vivants et les morts, et au nom de son apparition et de son royaume,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕያዋንና በሙታንም ሊፈርድ ባለው በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት፥ በመገለጡና በመንግሥቱም እመክርሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long suffering and doctrine.
verses.fr: prêche la parole, insiste en toute occasion, favorable ou non, reprends, censure, exhorte, avec toute douceur et en instruisant.
verses.am: ቃሉን ስበክ፥ በጊዜውም አለጊዜውም ጽና፥ ፈጽመህ እየታገሥህና እያስተማርህ፥ ዝለፍና ገሥጽ ምከርም።

verses.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.fr: Car il viendra un temps où les hommes ne supporteront pas la saine doctrine; mais, ayant la démangeaison d''entendre des choses agréables, ils se donneront une foule de docteurs selon leurs propres désirs,
verses.am: ሕይወት የሚገኝበትን ትምህርት የማይታገሡበት ዘመን ይመጣልና፤ ነገር ግን ጆሮቻቸውን የሚያሳክክ ስለ ሆነ፥ እንደ ገዛ ምኞታቸው ለራሳቸው አስተማሪዎችን ያከማቻሉ።

verses.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.fr: détourneront l''oreille de la vérité, et se tourneront vers les fables.
verses.am: እውነትንም ከመስማት ጆሮቻቸውን ይመልሳሉ፥ ወደ ተረትም ፈቀቅ ይላሉ።

verses.en: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.fr: Mais toi, sois sobre en toutes choses, supporte les souffrances, fais l''oeuvre d''un évangéliste, remplis bien ton ministère.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ነገርን ሁሉ በልክ አድርግ፥ መከራን ተቀበል፥ የወንጌል ሰባኪነትን ሥራ አድርግ፥ አገልግሎትህን ፈጽም።

verses.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.fr: Car pour moi, je sers déjà de libation, et le moment de mon départ approche.
verses.am: በመሥዋዕት እንደሚደረግ፥ የእኔ ሕይወት ይሠዋልና፥ የምሄድበትም ጊዜ ደርሶአል።

verses.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.fr: J''ai combattu le bon combat, j''ai achevé la course, j''ai gardé la foi.
verses.am: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድዬአለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሼአለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤

verses.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.fr: Désormais la couronne de justice m''est réservée; le Seigneur, le juste juge, me la donnera dans ce jour-là, et non seulement à moi, mais encore à tous ceux qui auront aimé son avènement.
verses.am: ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ ያን ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል፥ ደግሞም መገለጡን ለሚወዱት ሁሉ እንጂ ለእኔ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.fr: Viens au plus tôt vers moi;
verses.am: በቶሎ ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤

verses.en: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.fr: car Démas m''a abandonné, par amour pour le siècle présent, et il est parti pour Thessalonique; Crescens est allé en Galatie, Tite en Dalmatie.
verses.am: ዴማስ የአሁኑን ዓለም ወዶ ትቶኛልና፥ ወደ ተሰሎንቄም ሄዶአል፤ ቄርቂስም ወደ ገላትያ ቲቶም ወደ ድልማጥያ ሄደዋል፤

verses.en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.fr: Luc seul est avec moi. Prends Marc, et amène-le avec toi, car il m''est utile pour le ministère.
verses.am: ሉቃስ ብቻ ከእኔ ጋር አለ። ማርቆስ ለአገልግሎት ብዙ ይጠቅመኛልና ይዘኸው ከአንተ ጋር አምጣው።

verses.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.fr: J''ai envoyé Tychique à Ephèse.
verses.am: ቲኪቆስን ግን ወደ ኤፌሶን ላክሁት።

verses.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.fr: Quand tu viendras, apporte le manteau que j''ai laissé à Troas chez Carpus, et les livres, surtout les parchemins.
verses.am: ስትመጣ በጢሮአዳ ከአክርጳ ዘንድ የተውሁትን በርኖሱንና መጻሕፍቱን ይልቁንም በብራና የተጻፉትን አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.fr: Alexandre, le forgeron, m''a fait beaucoup de mal. Le Seigneur lui rendra selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: የናስ አንጥረኛው እስክንድሮስ እጅግ ከፋብኝ፤ ጌታ እንደ ሥራው ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.fr: Garde-toi aussi de lui, car il s''est fortement opposé à nos paroles.
verses.am: አንተም ደግሞ ከእርሱ ተጠበቅ፥ የምንናገረውን እጅግ ተቃውሞአልና።

verses.en: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.fr: Dans ma première défense, personne ne m''a assisté, mais tous m''ont abandonné. Que cela ne leur soit point imputé!
verses.am: በፊተኛው ሙግቴ አንድ ስንኳ አልደረሰልኝም፥ ሁሉም ተዉኝ እንጂ፤ ይህንም አይቍጠርባቸው፤

verses.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.fr: C''est le Seigneur qui m''a assisté et qui m''a fortifié, afin que la prédication fût accomplie par moi et que tous les païens l''entendissent. Et j''ai été délivré de la gueule du lion.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የስብከቱ ሥራ በእኔ እንዲፈጸም አሕዛብም ሁሉ እንዲሰሙት፥ ጌታ በእኔ አጠገብ ቆሞ አበረታኝ፥ ከአንበሳ አፍም ዳንሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur me délivrera de toute oeuvre mauvaise, et il me sauvera pour me faire entrer dans son royaume céleste. A lui soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ጌታም ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ያድነኛል ለሰማያዊውም መንግሥት ይጠብቀኛል፤ ለእርሱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.fr: Salue Prisca et Aquilas, et la famille d''Onésiphore.
verses.am: ለጵርስቅላና ለአቂላ ለሄኔሲፎሩም ቤተ ሰዎች ሰላምታ አቅርብልኝ።

verses.en: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.fr: Eraste est resté à Corinthe, et j''ai laissé Trophime malade à Milet.
verses.am: ኤርስጦስ በቆሮንቶስ ቀረ፥ ጥሮፊሞስን ግን ታሞ በሚሊጢን ተውሁት።

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.fr: Tâche de venir avant l''hiver. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, et tous les frères te saluent.
verses.am: ከክረምት በፊት እንድትመጣ ትጋ። ኤውግሎስና ጱዴስ ሊኖስም ቅላውዲያም ወንድሞችም ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል።

verses.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.fr: Que le Seigneur soit avec ton esprit! Que la grâce soit avec vous!
verses.am: ጌታ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከመንፈስህ ጋር ይሁን። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
